text:
Sam: ClearPath Health wants SOC 2 + ISO certs and a signed permissioned pen-test letter before we spin up their POC. Also asked if Dedicated vs Private changes pricing and whether customer-managed KMS is supported. They want a quick estimate.

Nina: We can package the SOC2 attestation + ISO certs and share a presigned bundle. Pen-test letter needs Security scope + Legal signature. If they require customer-managed KMS for staging, that will add integration effort.

Carlos: Quick ask: is the POC intended for Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Dedicated is quickest (~3 business days after approvals). Private/on-prem is multi-week due to procurement.

Sam: Customer said isolation + key control is non-negotiable. Theyre okay with Dedicated if the delta is reasonable.

Priya: Pricing guidance: if they want Dedicated with isolated KMS + permissioned pen-test, recommend a one-time assurance/setup fee of $7,000 (covers KMS onboarding, network isolation, security review). Dedicated runtime pricing unchanged; Private/on-prem is custom and requires scoping.

Carlos: Draft pen-test authorization to hand to Legal / customer (fill dates/IPs when confirmed):

```
Permissioned Pen-Test Authorization — ClearPath Health POC
- Customer: ClearPath Health
- Scope: POC application + network (customer to provide CIDR/IPs)
- Proposed test window: 2025-03-10 to 2025-03-14
- Exclusions: physical premises, social engineering
- Testing type: permissioned (no physical or human testing)
- Requirements: proof of insurance and basic indemnity confirmation
- POC contact: security@redwood.com
- Signatures: Redwood Legal + Customer
```

Maya (Legal): I can sign once Security confirms scope and indemnity language. Please include final window and insurance confirmation before I sign.

Priya: I'll add the one-time assurance fee to the quote and flag Billing once customer acknowledges.

Sam: Can someone upload the certs? We should send them before asking for the signed pen-test letter.

AuditBot: artifacts uploaded: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/clearpath/2790012345/evidence_bundle.zip (expires in 7 days)

Nina: Looping @Maya and @security to finalize. Carlos, please confirm whether pen-test will be authenticated or unauthenticated — that affects scope.

Carlos: Need customer to confirm: (1) Dedicated vs Private, (2) customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed, (3) test window and whether tests are authenticated. Once they confirm, Security will finalize scope (~2 business days) and Legal will sign.

Sam: I'll reply to ClearPath: include the artifact link, the pen-test template asking them to confirm scope and dates, and the $7,000 one-time assurance/setup fee if they need KMS separation. Ask them to confirm Dedicated vs Private and insurance by EOD Tue.

Priya: If they accept assurance fee and pick Dedicated we can have infra ready in ~3 business days. If Private/on-prem, expect 3+ weeks and additional quoting.

Sam: Thanks all :thumbsup: Will paste customer reply here when I get it.
